goal: Add only a read-only category refresh that reloads categories, clears dependent views, and restores deterministic category focus
tests_required: compile runtime and targeted refresh test
refresh re-reads categories from the data port
refresh clears entry and field views
non-empty refresh selects first category and focuses category list
empty refresh leaves no category index and focuses category list
tests_explicitly_not_run: web/browser regression because CP-07H is untouched
repository/domain regression because frozen core is untouched
new screenshot because Iteration 29 is not a fifth-iteration screenshot milestone
risks: refresh intentionally resets selection to the first category instead of preserving identity
refresh is user-triggered only; no polling or background reload is introduced
expected_side_effects: dependent entry and field lists are cleared before the refreshed category state is exposed
focus deterministically returns to the category list
